The '''trihexalon-based rooze''' was a mutagenic plague, possibly derived from the [[trihexalon]] [[bioweapon]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the genetic terrorist [[Zeta Magnus]] once threatened to release it on a random [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] if the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] refused to recognize his sovereign rule.
